goal: Master Prefix/suffix tricks, two pointers on strings, in-place swaps, Kadane, hashmap lookups.
tips: Focus on array manipulation invariants and edge cases (empty arrays, duplicates, single elements).

goal: Master frequency maps, sorted array 2-pointer convergence, and fixed/dynamic sliding window.
tips: For sliding window, clearly define window expansion (right pointer) vs contraction (left pointer) condition.

topics: Sliding Window, Prefix Sum, Binary Search, Sorting, Bit Manipulation
goal: Master binary search on values/answers (predicate monotonic check), prefix sum 2D, and merge sort inversions.
tips: Binary search on answers: establish low/high boundaries and the isValid() monotonic predicate.

topics: Bit Manipulation, Math, Linked List, Stack
goal: Master XOR tricks, dummy nodes, fast/slow pointer cycle detection, in-place reversal, and monotonic stack basics.
tips: Always use dummy head for linked list problems to eliminate boundary condition checks for the head node.

goal: Master Monotonic stack (next greater), Top-K heaps, sweep-line interval merges, and greedy interval scheduling.
tips: Interval problems: always sort by start time (or end time) and visualize overlaps with a timeline.

goal: Master Backtracking state template (choose -> explore -> un-choose), DFS tree traversals, and LCA.
tips: In recursion, draw the call stack diagram for small input n=3 to clearly trace backtrack states.

topics: Binary Trees, BST, Tries, Graph Traversal
goal: Master BST inorder sorted property, Trie prefix tree lookups, and Multi-source BFS on 2D grids.
tips: Trie nodes need an array/map of children and an isEndOfWord boolean. Grid BFS: mark visited immediately upon enqueueing.

topics: Graph Traversal, Topological Sort, Shortest Path, Union-Find, MST, 1D DP
goal: Master Kahn's algorithm (indegree queue), Dijkstra (min-heap), Disjoint Set with path compression, and 1D DP.
tips: Start applying and getting referrals around Week 8, as company hiring pipelines typically take 3-5 weeks!

topics: 1D DP, Grid DP, LIS, String DP, Knapsack
goal: Master 2D grid DP, LCS/Edit Distance string tables, and 0/1 vs Unbounded Knapsack patterns.
tips: For DP, write the recursive relation with memoization first, then convert to iterative table to optimize space.

topics: Knapsack, Stock DP, Interval DP, Tree DP, Bitmask, Design, Advanced DS, Mixed
goal: Complete remaining hard DP families (Burst Balloons, Tree DP), Design LRU/Twitter, and Segment Tree basics.
tips: Congratulations on finishing all 300 problems! Consolidate your pattern cheat-sheet for review.

goal: Redo every problem you flagged for revision. Complete Amazon (19) and Google (15) revision sets timed.
tips: Participate in 2 live or virtual LeetCode contests to build real-time problem-solving resilience.

topics: Mock Interviews, System Design, Core CS & Behavioral
goal: Simulate real interview conditions with verbal explanation. Deep dive into OS, DBMS, CN, OOP, and Project defense.
